answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-backed identity bonding at the social graph vertex: each agent must lock tokens at its identity vertex, and that locked stake is the lotus that blooms only after a bonding period during which attestations carry no reward. Sybil farms must therefore park real capital behind every fake identity, and their nectar — the staked tokens — gets slashed if peers attest fraud. This cost asymmetry makes mass identity creation unprofitable, keeping honest agents' attestations reliable.
